clue.text: It requires time to send rude messages

clue.text: This can be hot and cold when picked up

clue.text: A prisoner entering with a snake

clue.text: New student more at liberty to keep quiet

clue.text: Start to feel — with no objectivity — you should enjoy yourself here

clue.text: Lockdown enforcer endlessly complained, unfortunately

endlessly means the word loses its last letter

explanation.definitionFit: During pandemic lockdowns uniformed officers enforced the stay-at-home rules, a topical description.

clue.text: Group in a right state, primarily worried about the end of Europe?

definitions.text: Group in a right state, primarily worried about the end of Europe?

indicators.note: worried means agitated, so the words gathered under it are shaken up
the end of means the final letter of the word that follows
primarily means just the first letter of the word state

clue.text: Italian sausage made using mostly old meat and lard

mostly means most of the word, losing its final letter

clue.text: Before the indication to stop, absolutely nothing is produced

clue.text: Pub meal main oddly lacking taste

indicators.note: oddly lacking means the letters in odd positions are dropped, keeping the even ones

clue.text: TV film seeing crazy politician getting elected

a candidate elected is in

clue.text: Bread products are eaten by older family members

clue.text: One inventor about to give away organisation's principal secret

clue.text: Battle site is somewhat muddy, presumably
